title: Text: DET Michele Wysocki ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: It was so nice that one day when we didn’t have the Ben soundtrack booming
Emphasized “It was so nice that one day when we didn’t have the Ben soundtrack booming ”
It was three solid days of bliss
Can I tell these interns to email you a day before if they need parking, and just put it on them to get it done
Yes, at least 24 hour notice please
And does it help if say they’re doing three games that week, for them to tell you which ones at the beginning of the week
The parking is for the series so it doesn’t matter. Credentials will still need to be requested by Chris through the site
I haven’t requested a credential for Omaha 🙊
